masked_input.decision: Don't refund the $35 Courtesy Pay fee.
masked_input.facts: This fee was already refunded on Sep 11.

options.description: We refund a Courtesy Pay fee when a deposit that posted the same day would have covered the payment if it had posted first. Refunds and transfers between the member's own accounts don't count as deposits.
Members in good standing can receive up to 3 fee refunds in any 12-month period. The 12 months end on the date of the fee being reviewed, and refunds of any fee type count.

Courtesy Pay is when the credit union pays an item, such as a card payment or a bill, that the account balance can't cover. The account goes below zero, and a Courtesy Pay fee is charged for the item.
Staff can approve a fee refund of up to $50. Larger refunds need a supervisor.
A member is in good standing when there is no unpaid balance on any account. The Account Standing policy explains what counts as unpaid.
